16:21 Local Time, 11:21 GMT, 16:51 IST: The light seems to be an issue here. The players are heading towards the pavilion. Play suspended due to bad light and around the same time play was stopped yesterday as well. Doesn't look like the light will improve. It's stumps on day 2.

16:24 Local Time, 11:24 GMT, 16:54 IST: Another day lost to bad light, with nearly 45 overs lost in total. Pakistan started well, and Saud Shakeel looked all set for a well-deserved ton before unfortunately strangling one down the leg side. Arafat Minhas provided crucial runs down the order to reach his maiden Test fifty, prompting Babar Azam to declare nine down and have a crack at Sri Lanka for an hour before tea. The Pakistani pacers made immediate inroads, snatching two early wickets, including the prized scalp of Dinesh Chandimal. Debutant Saqib Khan has looked impressive, picking up two wickets to put the hosts in command. Sri Lanka still face a steep climb and desperately need a big partnership tomorrow to edge closer to Pakistan's total. Can Sri Lanka fight their way back on Day 3, or will Pakistan press home their advantage? That's all we have for you today, take care and good night!
